privacy.title: Privacy Policy

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Cyna SAS places the utmost importance on protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your data when using our platform cyna.fr.
s1.p2: We process your data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — EU Regulation 2016/679) and the French Data Protection Act (Loi Informatique et Libertés, as amended).

s2.title: 2. Data controller
s2.p1: The data controller is Cyna SAS, with its registered office at 10 Rue de la Paix, 75001 Paris, France, registered under number 123 456 789 00010 (RCS Paris B 123 456 789).
s2.p2: For any questions about your personal data, you can contact us:
s2.dpo: DPO (Data Protection Officer): privacy@cyna.fr — Cyna SAS, 10 Rue de la Paix, 75001 Paris, France

s3.title: 3. Data collected
s3.intro: We collect the following categories of data:

id.title: Identification data
id.content: Full name, email address, password (hashed via bcrypt, unreadable), email verification status.

address.title: Address data
address.content: Billing and delivery addresses (address line, city, postal code, country). These addresses are also stored as snapshots in each order history to ensure traceability.

order.title: Order and payment data
order.content: Order history (items, quantities, amounts, status), Stripe transaction ID, amount, currency, payment type (one-time or subscription), Stripe customer ID (stripe_customer_id) linked to your account for recurring payments.

auth.title: Authentication data
auth.content: Session tokens (refresh token, "remember me" token) stored in hashed form in the database. Temporary tokens for email confirmation and password reset (hashed, single-use). Two-factor authentication (2FA) codes — 6-digit codes, valid for 5 minutes, deleted after verification.

logs.title: Technical logs
logs.content: HTTP method, request path, response code, processing duration and timestamp. These logs are stored in secure files on the server and used only for debugging and security purposes.

s4.title: 4. Purposes and legal bases for processing

rows.purpose: Order and payment processing via Stripe
Compliance with legal and accounting obligations

s5.title: 5. Retention periods
s5.intro: We retain your data for the period strictly necessary for the purposes for which it was collected:
items: Account data: duration of contractual relationship + 3 years after termination
Orders and invoices: 10 years (legal accounting obligations)
Technical logs: 12 rolling months
Authentication tokens (refresh, remember-me): configured validity period (session or until logout)
Temporary tokens (email, reset, 2FA): deleted after use or expiration (5 minutes for 2FA codes)

s6.title: 6. Recipients of data
s6.intro: Your data may be transmitted to the following categories of recipients:
items: Stripe Inc. (United States) — payment provider: transaction processing, subscription management and Stripe customer ID storage. Transfer governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
Google LLC via Gmail SMTP — transactional email provider (email confirmation, password reset, 2FA codes).
OVHcloud (hosting provider) — hosting of the Platform's technical infrastructure.
Competent authorities when legally required.
s6.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.

s7.title: 7. Your rights
s7.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Right of access: obtain a copy of the data we process about you
Right to rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure: obtain the deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Right to restriction: suspend the processing of your data in certain cases
Right to portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interest
Right to withdraw consent: at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing
s7.p1: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@cyna.fr. We will respond within one month. You may also file a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority (CNIL in France: www.cnil.fr).

s8.title: 8. Data security
s8.p1: Cyna SAS implements all appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of your data, including: encrypted communications (TLS/SSL), password and token hashing (bcrypt), two-factor authentication (2FA), rate limiting, access logging and strict access controls between microservices.
s8.p2: In the event of a data breach likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will inform you as soon as possible in accordance with Article 34 of the GDPR.

s9.title: 9. Cookies
s9.p1: Our Platform uses technical cookies necessary for its operation (session management, security). For more information, please see our Cookie Policy.

s10.title: 10. Changes
s10.p1: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. In the event of a substantial change, we will inform you by email or through a Platform notification.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

s1.title: 1. What is a cookie?
s1.p1: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. It is read by the server on subsequent visits and helps improve your browsing experience by storing certain information.
s1.p2: Cookies cannot launch programs or transmit viruses. They are associated only with the browser you use and do not allow you to be personally identified without additional data.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies
necessary.p1: These cookies are essential for the Platform to function and cannot be disabled. They include:
items: User session management (JWT authentication)
Shopping cart
Language preferences
CSRF protection (form security)
Cookie consent storage
necessary.duration: Retention period: session duration or up to 12 months.

functional.title: Functional cookies
functional.p1: These cookies allow us to remember your preferences to personalize your user experience.
items: Display preferences
Recently viewed products
Saved catalog filters

s3.title: 3. Third-party cookies
s3.p1: Certain third-party services integrated into our Platform may place cookies on your device. These cookies are subject to the privacy policies of the companies that issue them.

rows.name: Stripe Inc.
rows.purpose: Secure payment processing and fraud prevention

s4.title: 4. Managing your preferences
s4.p1: On your first visit to our site, a cookie management banner allows you to accept or refuse non-essential cookies. You can change your preferences at any time.
s4.p2: You can also configure your browser to refuse all or some cookies. Instructions vary by browser:
browsers: Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies
s4.p3: Note: disabling cookies necessary for the site's operation may impair your experience and prevent access to certain features.

s5.title: 5. Consent duration
s5.p1: Your consent (or refusal) is stored for 6 months. After this period, your agreement will be requested again.

s6.title: 6. Legal basis
s6.p1: In accordance with CNIL guidelines and the requirements of Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act, non-essential cookies are only placed after collecting your express, free, informed, and unambiguous consent.
